summary: Plans the May 1971 Network Working Group meeting in Atlantic City. The chair wanted talks organized around advertised topics with written status reports and position papers, split into phases beginning with site status reports and introductions of new sites. Several other RFCs, such as 131, 152 and 156, are replies with status reports.

eli5.summary: Before a big club meeting, the leader says what the schedule will be. First everyone tells what they have done, then they talk about the big topics.
